in_marathi.name: Ekadash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekadash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekadash refers to the eleventh Rudra (Shiva), a deity in Hinduism. It is also a term for the eleventh day of the lunar fortnight.

in_bengali.name: Ekadash
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ekadash একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ekadash refers to the eleventh Rudra (Shiva), a deity in Hinduism. It is also a term for the eleventh day of the lunar fortnight.
